summary.headline: Chapter One: Reception
summary.text: Chapter One defines astrological reception through exaltations, planetary houses, bodily conjunctions, and the seven aspects. Examples involving Saturn and Mars in Aries and Capricorn explain mutual reception, priority in conjunction, and the greater force of exaltations relative to houses.
